create_dp_client: create a DPClient instance with a dataset and privacy settings for differential privacy training
prepare_dp_training: prepare a model for differentially private training by attaching the Opacus privacy engine and DPOptimizer
get_privacy_budget: get the current privacy budget epsilon and delta values from the RDP accountant after training
post_train_dp: finalize differential privacy training by computing the final privacy budget and detaching the GradSampleModule
configure_dp_client: configure a DPClientConfig dataclass with a PrivacySetting including noise multiplier and gradient clipping values
